name: MultiChoiceChips
tagline: Multi Choice Chips replaces the standard drop-down for a Choices (multi-select choice) column.
description: Multi Choice Chips replaces the standard drop-down for a Choices (multi-select choice) column. Instead of opening a list and ticking boxes, every option is shown as a chip on the form. Tap a chip to select it (it fills with colour and shows a tick); tap it again to remove it. You can see at a glance what has been chosen and what has not.
